title: A regulatory filing shows that Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) could r
text:
A regulatory filing shows that Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) could release two new iPads soon.
The company received permission from the Eurasian Economic Commission to market the A1893 and A1954 tablets running iOS 11. Those model numbers don’t correspond to iPads already on the market. 
Music maker: In an interview with Fast Company , CEO Tim Cook responds to a question that mentions Apple Music isn’t a money-maker: “You’re right, we’re not in it for the money. I think it’s important for artists. If we’re going to continue to have a great creative community, [artists] have to be funded.” 
Apple shares are up 1.1% .
